newsitem.title: UK: Andersen Consulting lifts 1996 revenue 26 percent.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Consulting lifts 1996 revenue 26 percent.

text.p: Management and technology consultancy firm Andersen Consulting said on Monday it raised it net revenue to $5.3 billion in 1996, a 26 percent increase over 1995.
It saw growth in all of its geographical areas with the largest rise, 32 percent, in Europe, Middle East, Africa and India where revenues grew to $1.9 billion.
Andersen Consulting is part of the same group as Arthur Andersen the international accountancy firm.
There has been some speculation that the two parts of the business might go their separate ways with talk of a market flotation for the Consulting arm.
